 ERCOT Batch Zero Process for Large Load Interconnection:
                     Affiliate Form
Instructions: This Affiliate Form (“Form”) must be completed by an authorized representative of
the designated Interconnecting Large Load Entity (“Designated ILLE”) and an authorized
representative of the Affiliate identified below. The authorized representative may be the same
individual for both the Designated ILLE and Affiliate. The Designated ILLE is providing this Form
in support of its eligibility determination under the ERCOT Batch Zero Process for Large Load
Interconnection. The Designated ILLE should record reliance on an affiliate in the first reserved
field in Section 4 of the Batch Zero Load Information Form. All fields must be completed unless
otherwise noted. This Form must be returned to the Interconnecting Transmission Service
Provider (“TSP”) or Interconnecting Distribution Service Provider (“DSP”), as applicable, with the
Designated ILLE’s other eligibility materials by the date specified in Planning Guide Revision
Request 145. If the Designated ILLE is relying on multiple affiliates to satisfy the eligibility criteria,
then it must submit a separate Affiliate Form for each affiliate. Questions regarding this Form may
be sent to: llwg_feedback@ercot.com.

Basis for Affiliate Status

The Designated ILLE and Affiliate represent that the Affiliate qualifies as an Affiliate of the
Designated ILLE. Check the applicable basis or bases for Affiliate status:

    ☐ A person who directly or indirectly owns or holds at least 5.0% of the voting securities or
      membership interests of the Designated ILLE;

    ☐ A person in a chain of successive ownership of at least 5.0% of the voting securities or
      membership interests of the Designated ILLE;

    ☐ A corporation that has at least 5.0% of its voting securities or membership interests
      owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by the ILLE;

    ☐ A corporation that has at least 5.0% of its voting securities or membership interests
      owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by:
